title: Restic: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116585)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the restic package due to its use of Go JOSE, which implements the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 0.18.1-r13. A fix is available in version 0.18.1-r13. The CVSS 4.0 base score is 6.9, indicating a medium severity issue.
